meta.defaultTitle: WithBot — Discord moderation that never sleeps
meta.defaultDescription: WithBot is a Discord moderation bot: AutoMod, anti-raid, warnings, logs, verification and a dashboard where you configure everything in minutes.
meta.featuresDescription: AutoMod, anti-raid, punishments, logs, verification, reaction roles, greetings and tickets — every WithBot module.

cookies.title: We respect your privacy
cookies.body: We use essential cookies to keep the site and dashboard working. With your consent we also use analytics cookies that help us improve WithBot.
cookies.necessaryDesc: Sign-in session, language, security. Always on.

hero.subtitle: WithBot stops spam, raids and toxicity before your members ever see them. Set it up in the dashboard in minutes — the rest happens on its own.
hero.sceneAlt: A 3D shield of chrome and black glass surrounded by orbiting particles — the symbol of WithBot protection.

trust.label: Trusted by communities across Poland and beyond

story.title: Every message passes through the filter.
story.sceneAlt: Visualization: message cards fall into a glowing filter, spam shatters into particles and clean messages pass through.

s1.title: Stream
s1.body: Thousands of messages per minute. WithBot sees every one of them the moment it is sent — no delay, no sampling.

s2.title: Analysis
s2.body: Six AutoMod modules check message rate, links, invites, mentions, caps and banned words — in under 15 ms.

s3.title: Response
s3.body: Spam disappears and the author gets a warning or timeout based on your thresholds. Every action is logged as a numbered case.

s4.title: Clean channel
s4.body: Your members see only the conversation. You see everything in the dashboard: what was stopped, when and why.

features.title: Everything a moderator needs.
features.subtitle: One bot instead of five. Turn every module on with a switch and fine-tune it with a slider.

automod.title: AutoMod
automod.subtitle: Enable modules, set sensitivity and decide what the bot does with a violation.
automod.bannedWordsHint: Type a word and press Enter. An asterisk (*) works as a wildcard.

ANTI_SPAM.name: Anti-spam
ANTI_SPAM.desc: Blocks message floods and repeated content.

ANTI_LINK.name: Anti-link
ANTI_LINK.desc: Removes links outside the domain allowlist.

ANTI_INVITE.name: Anti-invite
ANTI_INVITE.desc: Blocks invites to other Discord servers.

WORD_FILTER.name: Word filter
WORD_FILTER.desc: Removes messages with banned words and their variants.

ANTI_CAPS.name: Anti-caps
ANTI_CAPS.desc: Reacts to messages written mostly in capital letters.

ANTI_MENTION.name: Anti-mention
ANTI_MENTION.desc: Stops mass mentions of users and roles.

antiraid.title: Anti-raid
antiraid.subtitle: Detects a sudden influx of accounts and stops a raid before it floods your channels.
antiraid.lockdownDesc: Instantly blocks @everyone from sending messages in every channel.
antiraid.lockdownConfirm: Enable lockdown? Members without moderator roles won't be able to send messages.
antiraid.summary: If {threshold} accounts join within {window} s, WithBot treats it as a raid.
